lessons.title: Get Set Up
lessons.description: Set up the workspace and tools you'll need for the rest of this module.

steps.title: Create a Workspace
steps.description:
Create a new workspace in Postman for this module.

1. Open Postman and click **Workspaces** in the header.
2. Click **Create Workspace**.
3. Name it **My Module Name** and set visibility to **Personal**.
4. Click **Create Workspace**.

Paste the workspace URL or ID below to verify.
